light_constant.meaning: Light rides the same amount of space per unit time at every radius, which is what makes its local speed a constant. Only the split varies.

scope_note: A construction check on one reference chart and one recorded run. It does not measure the actual universe. The identity is exact for this family and says nothing about any other; the comparison between the reference zero and the evolved trapping horizon is a consistency check, not a derivation of one from the other.

shift_drift.beta_is_the_only_radius_varying_quantity: the lapse is identically one and the speed sum is identically two; the shift carries all of the spatial variation

what_this_measures: That the causal structure of this metric reduces to one radius-varying quantity. The lapse is pinned, the two characteristic speeds sum to twice it, and the shift is the only thing that changes with radius. The horizon is where the shift has drifted far enough for the outgoing leg to go negative.
